correctness.rationale: The d-dimensional orthant-simplex Dirichlet integral gives every even moment exactly. Bonnet recurrence yields an inductive closed integral formula for all moments of the reversed Legendre polynomial, and compact-support moment determinacy identifies the actual density. Real Legendre roots imply positive decreasing/log-concave density, and sine integration by parts gives positivity on (0,pi]. A finite polynomial Fourier endpoint expansion and Rouché argument exclude distant nonreal zeros, show eventual simple real zeros and give the O_d(n^-3) phase expansion.
